route: independent second route (crosscheck), written from the frozen page without the run's script or outputs and without the package
readings: Populations follow the page's description. PLANTEUR: 6 configurations x 3 embeddings of exp113's window arrays (pred = map class, true = reference). LCMAP: exp92's lcmap and esri columns at all its plots (reference ref), and exp112's pred at rows with in_fit_1000 == '0' and has_embedding == '1'. Suite: every exp78 unit file whose family is 'classification' (reference y; err is checked to equal dec != y), plus sen1floods11 (truth = dec where err == 0, the other of its two classes where err == 1); the other segmentation files are left out. The script counts what this yields and refuses unless the count equals --expect-count (default 40, the page's number).

C is the legend's class count (8 for PLANTEUR and LCMAP; n_classes of the unit file for the suite), not the number of classes present. Share intervals at level 1 - 0.05/C; the PA's two count intervals at 1 - 0.05/(2C); the P1 bar is 1 - 0.05/C for both.

Interval for a population count from k of n: every K in 0..N with P_K(X >= k) > alpha/2 and P_K(X <= k) > alpha/2 (strict), alpha = 1 - level, reported as K/N; found by bisection on each tail (each monotone in K).
Map codes outside the legend (LCMAP/Esri code 0; an empty exp112 pred, read as -1) stay in the population and count toward no class's M_c. A reference outside the legend refuses the run.
PLANTEUR legend: the observed codes of pred and true must fit 0..7 or 1..8 (8 classes); otherwise refuse.
Graded classes are those with K_c > 0 for every arm and prediction (P4 included); classes with K_c = 0 are neither reported nor graded.
Budgets b in {100, 400, 1000}: n = min(b, N); graded when b < N; a census (b >= N) is computed at n = N and reported with graded = false. P3-P5 use b = 400 on maps with N > 400.
Flag: too little when M_c < K_lo (m_c below the share interval), too much when M_c > K_hi, with the share interval at level 1 - 0.05/C. P4 adds the two disjoint probabilities.
PA interval: lower A_lo/K_hi (0 when K_hi = 0); upper 1 when K_lo = 0, else min(1, A_hi/K_lo, M_c/K_lo). Its coverage of A_c/K_c and 'upper <= 0.25' are decided in integer arithmetic.
Median width: the lower median (smallest w with P(W <= w) >= 1/2) under the exact sampling distribution; share width (K_hi - K_lo)/N; PA width max(0, upper - lower).
Thresholds p_c >= 0.05, m_c <= p_c/2, |m_c - p_c| <= 0.02 and PA_c <= 0.10 are decided in integers (20 K >= N, 2 M <= K, 50 |M - K| <= N, 10 A <= K).

P1 and P2 compare floating-point sums of exact probabilities with their bars: a shortfall below 1e-9 is counted as numerical noise (reported as strict_shortfalls), a larger one as a failure. P3-P5 compare without tolerance.
Joint share coverage: a sequential convolution over the reference classes present (k_1 ~ Hyp(N, K_1, n); k_2 | k_1 ~ Hyp(N - K_1, K_2, n - k_1); ...), keeping only each k_j whose interval covers K_j.
PA sums: P(a, k) = Hyp(k; N, K_c, n) x Hyp(a; K_c, A_c, k), which is the three-category multivariate hypergeometric of (a, k - a, n - k), summed over every (a, k) of its support.
not_computed: No comparison with the run's script or outputs (by design of the second route).
No designs other than simple random sampling (the confidence-stratified design is out of the page's scope).
Census budgets (b >= N) are reported, not graded.
Classes with K_c = 0 (reference absent) get no share or PA arm, even when the map draws them.
The segmentation unit files without a reference class (all but sen1floods11) are not used.
User's accuracy, overall accuracy and area-adjusted estimates are not computed.
Flag and PA-bound probabilities at budgets other than 400 are reported but not graded.
Interval widths are summarised by the median only (no other quantiles).
